entry.name: rnbo_buffer~
entry.digest: A data buffer for holding audio (or potentially some other) data.
entry.description: A data buffer. Two variations on this object can be used and are for the most part interchangeable. The buffer~ object creates a shared memory space between rnbo~ and Max, allowing rnbo~ buffers to be filled from the Max side and also for waveform previewing. The data object, which does not share memory with Max, supports the "@external 0" mode, which hides the buffer from the external world in the exported code.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The first argument of buffer~ (and data) is required and is the name that other objects use to access the stored buffer data. A buffer~ with the same name in a rnbo~ object and a parent Max patcher can share data in either direction, whereas a data object cannot.

arguments.name: samples
arguments.digest: Size in Samples. Take care when setting, allocation might block audio processing.
arguments.description: Set the size of the buffer in samples.The actual duration of the buffer is determined by the number of samples and the sample rate. (cr) It is important to note that large buffers can take time to allocate and may interrupt audio processing, so it is best not to use arbitrarily large buffers.

arguments.name: size
arguments.digest: Size in Samples. Take care when setting, allocation might block audio processing.
arguments.description: Set the size of the buffer in samples.The actual duration of the buffer is determined by the number of samples and the sample rate. (cr) It is important to note that large buffers can take time to allocate and may interrupt audio processing, so it is best not to use arbitrarily large buffers.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.digest: Change channel count. Take care when setting, allocation might block audio processing.
arguments.description: Set the number of channels for the data buffer. Requires that thebe set. If buffer is referencing an external source using theattribute, the number of channels is automatically determined by the source file."

arguments.name: samplerate
arguments.description: Sets the sample rate for the buffer object (default = 44100). This can be set independently from the sample rate of the audio driver and other buffer objects.
